nodes.label: Backend Development Contract (casca)
nodes.rationale: AI-as-senior-engineer contract: always start with a complete Zod schema, generate a fully functional Controller, but deliver Services as empty shells (signature + JSDoc only). Never implement RPA/Playwright logic, never mix DB/automation into Controllers, never invent env-var values. Preserves the developer's technical ownership of business logic while accelerating boilerplate.
